description: This Java class 'DatabaseUtil' provides utility methods for database operations including loading database drivers, executing SQL queries via Hibernate sessions or direct connections, and fetching distinct non-null column values. It is used within the OpenMRS healthcare platform for database-related tasks.

classes.name: DatabaseUtil
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for database driver loading, executing SQL queries, and retrieving distinct column values.

methods.name: loadDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Loads the database driver class based on connection URL and driver name; defaults to common database drivers if driver name is not specified.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL query either via Hibernate Session or JDBC Connection, enforcing 'select only' constraints if specified.

methods.name: getUniqueNonNullColumnValues
methods.description: Retrieves all distinct, non-null values from a specified column in a given table.
